description: This file provides utility functions to check configuration status and connectivity to a Supabase backend service, including environment variable validation and a lightweight ping (session retrieval) to verify client-server connectivity.

methods.name: checkSupabaseConfig()
methods.description: Checks if Supabase configuration details (URL and API key) are set in environment variables, returning an object indicating configuration status and URL.

methods.name: pingSupabase()
methods.description: Performs a lightweight authentication session request to Supabase to verify connectivity, returning success status and data or error information.
